claims.statement: Figma's OAuth apps documentation describes an OAuth 2 access token returned by POST /v1/oauth/token as access_token with token_type "bearer" and expires_in, sent as an Authorization: Bearer header, and expiring after 90 days by default.

sources.supports: you will receive the user access token and token expiration (in seconds) in a JSON response ... "access_token": <TOKEN>, "token_type": "bearer", "expires_in": ... pass a Bearer authorization header
By default, access tokens expire after 90 days.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Candidate only: the page shows only a <TOKEN> placeholder and states no prefix, alphabet, length or other format. Not researched beyond existence; no format is inferred.
